provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: eval-based cd (L50, L205) changes the working directory mid-script; plots/ paths at L344/L407/L473 are relative to fdir_curr
audit_member_text: All binary opens/reads assume success and exactly 960*480 singles (L54-L175); fileID and element counts are unchecked, and `cd` is changed via eval, so an early error can leave the caller in the results directory.

base_member_text: vbh=[0.0:1.0:3:0] (L278) is malformed (colon expression 3:0 is empty) but vbh is never used
audit_member_text: The statement `vbh=[0.0:1.0:3:0]` at L278 has four colon operands and is not a valid MATLAB colon expression; it executes even though `vbh` is unused, so it can stop the script before the remaining figures. The following contour uses a separate valid `[0:0.1:3]` at L279, consistent with a copied `3.0` typo.

base_member_text: the residuals Rx/Ry (L201-L202) sum all budget terms with plus signs; whether sign conventions of the model outputs make these true residuals (should be ~0) or net forcing cannot be verified without the model source
yy2 (middle row nn1) is computed (L218) but all its plot lines are commented out; icount (L27) unused
binary reads assume FUNWAVE binary output format (m n) single precision with no header; byte order/format not verifiable from this file
figure 1 caption labels X1/X2 for rows and Y1-Y4 for columns while variables are named nn (rows) and mm (columns); fig numbering order in file is 1,3,2

audit_member_text: Only Hsig/etamean/velocity/budget fields are accumulated and averaged over numb=2:3 (L59-L195). `eta` is overwritten on each iteration at L53-L57 and the map at L239 therefore shows only the last snapshot (numb=3) beside panels labeled from two-snapshot averages, an inconsistent temporal aggregation.

Every momentum-profile panel places its letter above the corresponding y-axis maximum: figure 3 uses 0.0014 vs ax1 max 0.0012 (L351,L374), 0.014 vs 0.012 (L352,L383), and 0.09 vs 0.075 for ax3/ax4 (L353-L354,L393,L403); figure 2 similarly uses 0.086>0.075, 0.15>0.135, 0.028>0.025, and 0.1>0.09 (L416-L419,L436,L445,L459,L469). With clipping, the subplot labels can be invisible.
`tmp`, `icount`, `vbh`, and several txt_x/txt_y assignments are unused; plot output also assumes a pre-existing `plots` directory.
